facts.business: The Byke Hospitality Limited operates a portfolio of over 1744 rooms across 35 properties in 12 states and 22 cities, owning, managing, and operating hotels through a combination of ownership, long-term lease, and management contracts, with a distinctive pure-vegetarian dining experience across its restaurants and banquets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Three new properties acquired and on track to become operational

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand footprint towards 100 hotels and resorts across the country

key_risks: Geopolitical developments in West Asia and related aviation disruptions could keep fuel, logistics, and utility costs elevated
Near-term performance may be affected by global travel volatility
facts.related_party_note: There were no materially significant related party transactions during the year that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company. Transactions with related parties are disclosed in the notes to the accounts forming part of this Annual Report.
